description: Cases parked on the macOS arm64 reference only (owner decision 2026-10-21; LEDGER 'ARM Reference'). The macOS job skips them (and lists them in its log) in sas-parity (SAS_PARITY_PARKED), the proxy compare and the hash checks (run_corpus.py --parked); every other job, including x86, keeps them live, hashed and gated. Every listed id must be a loaded case (not pending/). Inputs and tolerances are unchanged. Remove an entry when its fix lands.
